rules.description: List of rules defining the protocol

mechanism: A marker interface. A pattern implementing 'Protocol' MUST state a rule set governing an exchange, and the exchange MUST hold between two or more parties — a procedure a single party runs against itself is a method, not a protocol. Formats, versioning and degree of formality are implementer concerns: HTTP pins all three, a ceremonial protocol pins none.
failure_modes: Version Drift: Agents attempting to communicate with incompatible protocol versions.
Ambiguous Spec: Rules that allow for multiple valid interpretations.
invariants: Rule set: an implementer must state the rules that govern the exchange.
Inter-party: the exchange must hold between two or more parties.
